items.difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that proper pushforward is compatible with composition, on cycle classes (statement lines 1923-1929, tag 02R0-adjacent). The proof reduces to an integral class, forms its images under the two proper morphisms, splits off the case where the final image has smaller dimension and both sides vanish, and in the remaining case computes both sides as products of degrees of the induced morphisms and compares them by multiplicativity of degrees. The degree computation is the substance, so the claim is H2.
